prompt: Our late Sunday drama about a noodle shop drew (more / 50,000) viewers.
explanation_ru: Перед числительным используется конструкция more than (более чем).

prompt: Did Brad's sunny street picnic really bring out more neighbours (we / expect)?
explanation_ru: После сравнительной степени more neighbours ставится союз than и придаточное предложение в прошедшем времени (than we expected).

prompt: Peggy's spring blood-donation weekend welcomed ___ thirty first-time donors, keeping biscuit trays busy.
explanation_ru: Перед числом нужна связка more than (больше тридцати). Частая ошибка — путать союз than (чем) с наречием then (затем).

prompt: After patient cleaning by Amira, the old Ismailia port book wasn't very (different / recent) records, yet it lasted (long / anyone / think).
explanation_ru: С прилагательным different используется предлог from (в британском варианте также to). Во втором пропуске после сравнительной степени longer идёт союз than и придаточное предложение.

prompt: Deep snow covered every beginner slope around our wooden lodge in Aspen. Check-in ran (smoothly / expected), even with skis piled by the door. Our cosy room wasn't (similar / the / picture) online — it had a bigger balcony. At the front desk, Wade handles busy mornings far better (I / do).
explanation_ru: Наречие smoothly образует сравнительную степень через more + than expected; после similar всегда нужен предлог to; после better ставится than I do для сравнения действий в настоящем времени.

prompt: Please read my note about Neil's new Doncaster helper, who sorted parcel crates (fast / everyone / else).
explanation_ru: Наречие fast образует сравнительную степень faster, после которой для сравнения с группой ставится than everyone else.

prompt: More then five hundred families visited Araceli's lantern show in the courtyard.
answer: More than five hundred families visited Araceli's lantern show in the courtyard.
accepted_answers: More than five hundred families visited Araceli's lantern show in the courtyard.
More than 500 families visited Araceli's lantern show in the courtyard.
explanation_ru: В сравнении с числом используется союз than (чем), а не слово then (тогда, затем): More than five hundred.

prompt: Mateus told reporters that the beachfront band drew (many / 800) dancers, far more (he / imagine).
explanation_ru: Для указания количества выше числа берётся more than + число, а во второй части после more идёт придаточное сравнения с союзом than.

prompt: Cecil's indoor bamboo grew much faster ___ and soon touched the high glass roof of the greenhouse.
explanation_ru: После сравнительной степени faster требуется союз than с придаточным предложением. Слова then, as и that здесь являются типичными ошибками.

prompt: Lois raised (more / £400) at her autumn book sale for local schools.
explanation_ru: Перед денежной суммой используется конструкция more than + число (более 400 фунтов).

prompt: You won't believe how good the park run in Pietermaritzburg was! The hilly route turned out to be much (easy / expected). Lively school drummers played along the ridge, making the mood completely (different / a / serious) race. Mandla still finished three minutes earlier than (I / do), though I didn't walk once.
explanation_ru: Здесь сочетаются три конструкции: сравнительная степень + than expected, прилагательное different + предлог from (или to) и глагол-заместитель did в прошедшем времени после than I.

prompt: Before arriving at Matsuyama tram station, Riku worried about reading old paper route maps in a foreign city. To his surprise, catching the wooden tram proved far (simple / he / fear), as smiling conductors guided passengers directly aboard. He didn't need to wait (long / five) minutes before the gleaming car rolled past the platform. Even the seats inside were the (same / the / wooden) benches in his grandfather's old postcards.

accepted_answers: more simple than he had feared

explanation_ru: После simpler и longer нужен союз than (с придаточным и с числом минут), а выражение the same всегда требует союза as, а не like.

prompt: According to Sigrun's report from Keflavik Airport, clear northern lights brought thousands more visitors in October (analysts / predict), filling every hotel bus.
explanation_ru: После сравнительной степени more visitors ставится союз than и придаточное предложение в Past Perfect или Past Simple (than analysts had predicted / predicted).

prompt: Kenichi fixed twelve bike chains at the campus clinic, and I only fixed five. → Kenichi fixed more bike chains at the campus clinic …
answer: Kenichi fixed more bike chains at the campus clinic than I did.
accepted_answers: Kenichi fixed more bike chains at the campus clinic than I did.
Kenichi fixed more bike chains at the campus clinic than me.
Kenichi fixed more bike chains at the campus clinic than I.
explanation_ru: После more ... для сравнения с другим человеком используется than I did (нейтрально) или разговорный вариант than me.

prompt: Local business news praised Darryl's Thunder Bay office because his team answers parcel claims much faster (other / depots / manage) without making extra mistakes.
explanation_ru: После сравнительной степени наречия faster сравнение продолжается союзом than и полноценным придаточным предложением (than other depots manage).

prompt: Hi Mum, I finished my German exam in Tubingen with Verena. It wasn't the (same / my / old) school tests at all. Our teacher gave us fun board games instead of long papers. Talking in groups was much easier (it / look) at first!
explanation_ru: С конструкцией the same всегда используется союз as (the same as), а после easier — союз than + придаточное в прошедшем времени (than it looked).

prompt: Starting at a shipping firm in Klaipeda made Rasa nervous, as she pictured silent desks and strict managers. Instead, her colleagues greeted her with warm honey cake and hand-drawn desk maps, so the office felt far (warm / she / picture). Her new routine didn't turn out to be (similar / her / previous) job, where nobody spoke before lunch. Even the senior clerk explained the shipping forms more patiently (her / old / boss) at her former company.
explanation_ru: В тексте проверяются три модели: warmer than + придаточное, similar + предлог to и сравнение наречия more patiently + than her old boss (did).

prompt: Why did Kenzo carry back more library books for free green tea ___?
explanation_ru: После сравнительной степени more ... books нужен союз than с подлежащим и вспомогательным глаголом (than I did). Варианты then, as и притяжательное my ошибочны.

prompt: Dirk's airport checklist says packing liquids in one clear pouch lets you clear security (quickly / most / passengers).

accepted_answers: more quickly than most passengers do

explanation_ru: Наречие quickly образует сравнительную степень с помощью more, после чего ставится союз than и объект сравнения.

prompt: Noemie laughed because her marked essay had the same coffee stain like Solene's.
answer: Noemie laughed because her marked essay had the same coffee stain as Solene's.
accepted_answers: Noemie laughed because her marked essay had the same coffee stain as Solene's.
explanation_ru: После конструкции the same ... всегда ставится союз as, а не like (the same coffee stain as Solene's).

prompt: Holger wrote to the Frankfurt building desk about the hallway water cooler. The water comes out lukewarm, not cold at all, and the kettle is broken too.
options: The hallway water is much warmer as it should be, so nobody can enjoy a cold drink.
The hallway water is much colder than Holger expected, so he does not need the broken kettle.
The hallway water is the same warm like the kettle, which is still working fine.
The hallway water is much warmer than it should be, and the broken kettle does not help.
explanation_ru: Последний вариант верно передаёт суть жалобы и правильно использует союз than перед придаточным (warmer than it should be). Остальные искажают смысл или содержат ошибки с as и like.

prompt: Tomasz and Magda thought the cheap grey stool would feel weak, yet it held up well. → The cheap grey stool felt much stronger …
answer: The cheap grey stool felt much stronger than Tomasz and Magda had thought.
accepted_answers: The cheap grey stool felt much stronger than Tomasz and Magda had thought.
The cheap grey stool felt much stronger than Tomasz and Magda thought.
The cheap grey stool felt much stronger than they had thought.
The cheap grey stool felt much stronger than they thought.
The cheap grey stool felt much stronger than Tomasz and Magda thought it would.
The cheap grey stool felt much stronger than they thought it would.
explanation_ru: Ожидание из исходного предложения передаётся после сравнительной степени через союз than и придаточное предложение (than Tomasz and Magda had thought / thought).

prompt: Do our new cordless desk lamps shine more softly (our / ceiling / lights) on rainy mornings in Setubal?
explanation_ru: После сравнительной степени наречия more softly сравнение вводится союзом than + существительное (можно также добавить вспомогательный глагол do).

prompt: "Wait a second — isn't that my navy suitcase?" Yasmine asked Saki at the Narita luggage belt. "Oh no, it feels much heavier (mine / be), so I definitely grabbed the wrong one!" Saki laughed. Both bags had scuffed wheels and orange tags, yet it took (less / two) minutes to swap them back. Afterwards, Yasmine admitted that Saki had lifted the case more easily (she / can).
explanation_ru: После сравнительной степени используется than + местоимение с глаголом (than mine is, than she could), а перед отрезком времени — связка less than + число (less than two minutes).

prompt: Maureen posted in the family chat from Cairns Airport after meeting her grandson. On his trip last year he barely spoke a word, whereas this visit he chatted happily about tropical parrots all the way to the car.
options: He talks much less this visit than last year, because the tropical parrots made him shy.
He is far more talkative this visit than he was last year, chatting happily about tropical parrots.
He is far more talkative this visit then he was last year, chatting happily about tropical parrots.
He is much more different from last year as he refused to say a word about parrots.
explanation_ru: Второй вариант точно описывает перемену и грамотно строит сравнение через than + придаточное (than he was last year). Третий вариант содержит частую ошибку then вместо than.

prompt: Signe reported that Aalborg's new electric shuttle bus runs far more quietly than the old diesel coaches did.
answer: Signe reported that Aalborg's new electric shuttle bus runs far more quietly than the old diesel coaches did.
accepted_answers: Signe reported that Aalborg's new electric shuttle bus runs far more quietly than the old diesel coaches did.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: после сравнительной степени наречия more quietly верно употреблён союз than и глагол-заместитель did в прошедшем времени.

prompt: Camilo joked while climbing the Medellin cable-car steps that he doesn't mind the steep stairs unless his orange bags weigh far more ___.
explanation_ru: После more требуется союз than и подлежащее в именительном падеже перед глаголом (than he can lift). Нельзя ставить объектное местоимение him перед глаголом или путать than с then.

prompt: Can Hyunwoo jump any higher (Jiwon) during their friendly school volleyball match?
explanation_ru: После сравнительной степени наречия higher сравнение с другим игроком вводится союзом than (than Jiwon или than Jiwon can).
